question: What kinds of material offerings should be presented to the deity?
premises: The verse names fragrance, flowers, and so on.
It extends this to whatever offerings there may be.
All such items are to be offered to the deity.
inference: All material offerings such as fragrance and flowers should be offered to the deity.
plain_english: Whatever there is, such as fragrance, flowers, and so on, one should offer all of it to the deity.
